Name: SupporterMod
Description: v0.3.0 - PHASE 2: chat identity. Supporters get a [Supporter] tag, an optional custom title and a chat colour, set with /supporter title and /supporter colour. The chat handler NEVER cancels PlayerChatEvent and never broadcasts anything itself - it calls setFormatter, so the server keeps ownership of delivery. That is what makes it safe alongside FactionMod: FactionMod cancels the event when a player has faction chat toggled on and re-broadcasts to their faction only, so a plugin that also cancelled and broadcast server-wide would leak private faction messages to everybody. With a formatter, if FactionMod has already cancelled then ours is simply never invoked. Titles are validated for length, control characters and a configurable blocklist - the rejection message deliberately does not name the matched word, because that would turn the blocklist into an oracle somebody can probe. Colours must be on the allowedChatColors list and are normalised to the configured spelling. Identity lives in its own table and OUTLIVES a lapse: an expired title stops rendering but is not deleted, so renewing restores exactly what the player had. Schema migration V2. 40 tests. ---  v0.2.2 - FIX: plugin data now lives in plugins/SupporterMod/ rather than the path getDataDirectory() returns, which is under mods/. The asset module scans mods/ for asset packs, so the database folder was picked up as a malformed pack and logged "Skipping pack at ThePeoplesServer_SupporterMod: missing or invalid manifest.json" on every boot. FactionMod uses plugins/<Name>/ for exactly this reason. If you are upgrading from 0.2.1, move mods/ThePeoplesServer_SupporterMod/supporter.db to plugins/SupporterMod/ to keep existing grants. --- v0.2.1 - FIX: the first live deploy failed with 'No suitable driver found for jdbc:sqlite:...' even though sqlite-jdbc was correctly shaded and META-INF/services/java.sql.Driver was present in the jar. DriverManager performs its ServiceLoader discovery once against the system classloader, and Hytale loads each plugin in its own PluginClassLoader, which the system classloader cannot see - so the driver never registers and DriverManager has nothing to return. Now connects through SQLiteDataSource, which holds the driver directly and never consults that global registry. This also keeps SupporterMod out of the way of the other plugins here that shade their own sqlite-jdbc (Windskull's Survival, Hunger and Thirst all do) rather than adding a fourth driver to a registry shared between them. Note for the record: SQLite works fine on this server - the earlier recon claim that there was no SQLite precedent was wrong. --- v0.2.0 - Phase 1 complete. The entitlement core is now wired to the server: SupporterPlugin lifecycle, the /supporter command tree, player-join claiming and the nightly reconcile job. Admin subcommands (grant, revoke, reconcile) extend CommandBase rather than AbstractPlayerCommand, because AbstractPlayerCommand requires a player and Tebex delivers purchases from the console - a player-only grant command would fail on every real purchase while working perfectly in testing. No optional positional arguments anywhere: withOptionalArg registers a named flag rendered as [--name=?], so a bare positional word is rejected as an unexpected required parameter. Startup failure is surfaced rather than swallowed - the server bundles no JDBC driver, so sqlite-jdbc unpacks a native library at first use and can fail at runtime in a way no compile check catches; if that happens every command reports the reason instead of the server booting with a silently dead supporter system that accepts grants and loses them. --- v0.1.0 - Supporter rank for The People's Server. Entitlement core only: grant, renewal, grace period and nightly expiry reconcile, backed by SQLite. Renewals extend from the existing expiry rather than from now, so buying early never costs time. Grants carrying a payment-provider transaction id are applied at most once, because Tebex retries delivery until the server acknowledges it. Nothing in this plugin touches combat, claims, power, outpost income, KOTJ scoring or the bucks economy.
